|lore=Male Trandoshan '''bounty hunter'''. Strong but clumsy. Extremely proud and arrogant. Suffered a humiliating defeat at the hands of Chewbacca and his partner Han Solo.
|game_text=Adds 2 to power of anything he pilots. While at same site as a smuggler, power +3. While with opponent’s smuggler or Wookiee, opponent may not draw more than one battle destiny here. Immune to attrition < number of opponent’s smugglers on table.
|printings={{Card versions/Bossk (Dagobah)}}
|notes=The remastered slip for Bossk uses the official text dated 4 December 2006. The published Set 5 editions are linked as [[Bossk (V) (Virtual Set 5: A Dark Time)|Original]] and [[Bossk (V) (Virtual Set 5: A Dark Time) (Errata)|Remastered (2006)]]. The first sheet was released 30 May 2003 and became tournament legal on 6 June. The [[:File:Dagobah-D-bossk-decipher-archive.gif|Decipher base card]] supplies Pilot and Warrior through the original slip’s cutout. The remastered slip prints both icons. Both editions give the same pilot and smuggler bonuses, the same opponent battle destiny cap and the same attrition immunity threshold.
|sources=* [https://web.archive.org/web/20071024154714/http://www.swccgpc.com/Resources/VirtualCards5.pdf#page=3 VirtualCards5.pdf] (Players Committee Remaster sheet, Internet Archive 24 October 2007) — official text as of 4 December 2006 (errata to card #49 on 14 September 2007); page 3, slip 29. Slip image and game text from this sheet.
